_meta.description: People who can be assigned tasks. expertise[].area references expertise_areas[].id; expertise[].level is 1-4 (see expertise_areas.levels). 'availability' is the contributor's declared state; current workload is NOT stored here - it is derived at runtime from active assignments (count and sum of estimated_effort_hours) and compared with max_concurrent_tasks and available_hours (hours free for assigned work in the planning window of 10 working days). Both limits are SOFT: exceeding either is logged as a capacity conflict and the task is queued with a warning; it does not make the contributor ineligible. All people are fictional.
